metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2023 · Beckham
metas.description: With never-before-seen footage, this docuseries follows David Beckham's meteoric rise from humble beginnings to global football stardom.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2023 · Arnold
metas.description: Follows the life of Arnold Schwarzenegger, from his days of lifting weights to his successes in Hollywood, his time serving as governor of California, and both the joys and volatility of his family life.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2022 · Conversations with a Killer: The John Wayne Gacy Tapes
metas.description: Never-before-heard audio from the interrogation of serial killer John Wayne Gacy threads through this chilling look at his 1970s murder spree.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Aka Charlie Sheen
metas.description: After 7 years sober, Charlie Sheen candidly discusses his rise to fame and public downfall, joined by family and friends who share untold stories of his journey through stardom, struggles, and redemption.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2022 · Conversations with a Killer: The Jeffrey Dahmer Tapes
metas.description: Serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer confesses to his gruesome crimes in unguarded interviews, offering an unsettling view into a disturbed mind.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · Mr. McMahon
metas.description: WWE experienced record-breaking highs and crushing lows under Vince McMahon's leadership and the mogul's controversial reign.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · Shiny Happy People
metas.description: Docuseries exploring the truth beneath the surface of reality TV's mega-family, The Duggars.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · Pee-wee as Himself
metas.description: A kaleidoscopic portrait told in two parts that traces the life of the imaginative artist.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2023 · Robbie Williams
metas.description: After 25 years of his record-breaking solo career, Robbie looks back on his younger self and reflects on a lifetime spent in the spotlight.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2023 · Love Has Won: The Cult of Mother God
metas.description: Chronicles the life and death of Amy Carlson, also known as Mother God, a self-proclaimed spiritual savior who built a cult through her online manifestos and live-streaming sessions.
